# MethodCache

> Cache any .NET method with one attribute. A .NET 10 library: a source generator turns `[Cache]` on interface methods into caching decorators at compile time, with keys built from the arguments, tag invalidation, a memory cache plus optional Redis, SQL Server or PostgreSQL, and policies you can change in appsettings.json or at runtime.

Put `[Cache]` and `[CacheInvalidate]` on interface methods (not classes), register services, then call `builder.Services.AddMethodCache()` after them. Every C# example in these docs is compiled in CI. For coding agents, [docs/ai/methodcache.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/ai/methodcache.md) is a compact rule set, [docs/how-to.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/how-to.md) answers common questions, the reference pages give the exact rules, and [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/llms-full.txt) has all the docs in one file, too large to read whole: read the page for your task from the list below, and search llms-full.txt for a term. The MethodCache NuGet package carries the same pages in its docs folder.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/getting-started.md): put `[Cache]` on an interface method and register it.
- [How do I…?](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/how-to.md): short answers to common questions, each with a link to the details.
- [Generated decorators](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/source-generator.md): supported signatures and forwarded interface members.
- [Cache keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/keys.md): how keys are built from the arguments, and how to control them.
- [Expiration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/expiration.md): duration, sliding expiration, refresh-ahead and versions.
- [Invalidation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/invalidation.md): tags with argument templates, keys and whole methods.
- [Entity Framework Core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/entity-framework-core.md): invalidate after every commit that changes a mapped entity.
- [Fail-safe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/fail-safe.md): serve the last good value when a dependency fails or is slow.
- [Conditional caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/conditional-caching.md): store only the results you want to keep.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/configuration.md): defaults, groups, `appsettings.json` with live reload, runtime overrides.
- [Manual caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/manual-caching.md): `GetOrCreateAsync` with a key you choose.
- [Caching third-party code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/third-party.md): cache a client from a NuGet package.
- [HTTP response caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/http-caching.md): `HttpClient` caching with `Cache-Control` and `ETag`.
- [Distributed cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/distributed-cache.md): share results between instances with Redis, SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
- [Monitoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/monitoring.md): statistics, admin endpoints, health check and OpenTelemetry.
- [Memory cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/memory-cache.md): size limits, null values and jitter.
- [Native AOT](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/native-aot.md): what to register when you publish with Native AOT.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/features/testing.md): test with caching on or off, count loads and invalidations, and check that every tag has an invalidation.
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/security.md): what each package protects against, and what it leaves to you.
- [Registration reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/reference/registration.md): how `AddMethodCache()` finds and wraps services, and keyed or generic registrations.
- [Distributed cache reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/reference/distributed.md): which calls use it, backplanes, invalidation results and serialization.
- [HTTP caching reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/reference/http-caching.md): variants, replaced responses, invalidation and administration details.
- [MethodCache: instructions for coding agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/ai/methodcache.md): rules to copy into Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code instructions.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): a method that isn't cached, stale data, keys you didn't expect.
- [Build diagnostics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/user-guide/DIAGNOSTICS.md): every `MC` warning and error.
- [Migrating from IMemoryCache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/docs/migration-from-imemorycache.md): replace hand-written cache-aside code.
- [MethodCache.Redis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.Redis/README.md): Redis as MethodCache's distributed cache.
- [MethodCache.SqlServer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.SqlServer/README.md): SQL Server as MethodCache's distributed cache.
- [MethodCache.PostgreSql](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.PostgreSql/README.md): PostgreSQL as MethodCache's distributed cache.
- [MethodCache.AspNetCore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.AspNetCore/README.md): Admin endpoints and a health check for MethodCache's in-memory cache.
- [MethodCache.OpenTelemetry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.OpenTelemetry/README.md): MethodCache produces standard .NET metrics and traces.
- [MethodCache.HttpCaching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.HttpCaching/README.md): HTTP caching for `HttpClient`, the way a browser does it: responses are cached according to `Cache-Control`, revalidated with `ETag` / `Last-Modified`, and a `304 Not Modified` comes back to your code as the full cached response.
- [MethodCache.Serialization.MessagePack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.Serialization.MessagePack/README.md): Stores MethodCache's distributed cache values (Redis, SQL Server or PostgreSQL) as compact MessagePack instead of the default System.Text.Json: smaller entries and faster reads.
- [MethodCache.EntityFrameworkCore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.EntityFrameworkCore/README.md): Invalidates MethodCache tags when Entity Framework Core commits a change.
- [MethodCache.Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/src/MethodCache.Testing/README.md): Helpers for tests of the caching itself: a fake clock, a recorder that counts how often your implementation ran and what was invalidated, and a check that every cache tag has something that invalidates it.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eoniclabs/MethodCache/main/CHANGELOG.md): Changes that a user of the packages notices.
